target_function.name: chamber_controller
target_function.boundary_source: Exact exported entry + PE x64 exception directory BeginAddress/EndAddress

source.scope: Controller input is exactly 6,7,8 selected before a run; harness is clean.

state_contract.sentinel_meaning: Harness initialization; not yet assigned by the controller.

stages.label: Input / entry
stages.description: Enter with the selected preset; pass the entry opaque gate.

stages.label: Calculate and compare
stages.description: Compute input * 3 + 1, compare it with 22, and consume the saved signed-less-than result.

stages.label: Compare high
stages.description: Compare the same value with 22 and consume the saved signed-greater-than result.

stages.label: LOW output
stages.description: Commit result LOW; bridge remains closed.

stages.label: HIGH output
stages.description: Commit result HIGH; bridge remains closed.

stages.label: MATCH / bridge open
stages.description: Commit MATCH and then write bridge_open = 1.

stages.label: Return / end
stages.description: Traverse the applicable merge blocks and return the committed result.

stages.label: Analysis candidate A
stages.description: Inspect this region's stores and control flow.

stages.label: Analysis candidate B
stages.description: Inspect this region's stores and control flow.

stage_graph.semantics: Union of retained execution transitions; validate against the selected occurrence, not this union.

raw.cfg_convention: Linear sweep within exact .pdata extent; leaders at function entry, direct branch targets, instructions following branches/returns, and audited compiler labels. Calls remain inside caller blocks. Compiler provenance is inherited until the next audited IR block label.

grouping.occurrence_rule: Consecutive mapped raw occurrences form a stage occurrence until the stage changes or a raw block repeats; repeated stages get a new visit_number.
grouping.unassigned_raw_blocks: Other proven clones are inspector-only, with null stage_id.

candidates.proof: Clone origin mapped from frozen IR through exact assembly/link-map audit symbols; both incoming edges follow universally taken JNE guards and are infeasible.
candidates.reachability_basis: All incoming normal-entry paths excluded by exact-native guard proof; trace absence only confirms consistency.

assumptions: Normal entry through chamber_controller and decoded direct control flow; no external jump into an interior instruction or clone.
Code bytes and normal x86-64 instruction semantics remain intact; no debugger/exception mechanism rewrites RIP or flags.
The two 32-bit global loads complete successfully; each loaded x and y may be arbitrary and may differ between guards.
Calls use their ordinary ABI and return to their call sites; no stack/control-flow corruption or return-address manipulation.
This establishes clone unreachability under those conditions, not whole-program equivalence for arbitrary inputs/pointers or hardware faults.

replay_contract.validation: Compare the proposed next stage with current_event.next_stage_id; on mismatch stop without advancing or firing future events.
replay_contract.input_changes: Restart from event 0 with the selected preset; never splice runs.
replay_contract.completion: Finish only when the end event has completed and next_event_id is null.
replay_contract.event_timing: Within each stage, process timeline entries by instruction step; do not pre-apply a stage final state.
replay_contract.physical_layout: Provided separately by the frontend; no coordinates in this bundle.
